caption: The drawing depicts a single brown candlestick or bottle-like object, centrally positioned on an off-white background. The object has a glossy surface with lighter highlights indicating reflections, and it features a series of bulbous, rounded segments that diminish in size toward the top. The base of the object is wide and circular, transitioning into a narrower, segmented middle and a slightly flared opening at the top. The lines outlining the object are clean, and the shading provides a sense of depth and three-dimensionality. The drawing is enclosed within a thin rectangular border, and the name "JANET RIZA" is printed in the lower right corner of the image, just inside the border. There are no other objects or decorative elements, and the background remains plain and unadorned.
title: Candlestick
